title: Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional Algerian slow-cooked stew made with lamb, lovely spices, and smoky flavors.

ingredients.name: Lovely spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-low heat.
Add the lovely spices and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoky paprika, olives, ginger, garlic, and chicken broth.
Bring to a simmer, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2-1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the honey, if using.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley, if desired.
